description: pkix-lint/src/report.rs:123-138 — Severity derives PartialOrd+Ord (Info < Warn < Error < Fatal), but findings_at_or_above uses a manual matches!() table instead. This is unmaintainable: adding a new Severity variant requires a manual table update or silently produces wrong results. The detail().is_some() guard is also redundant (Warn/Error/Fatal always have detail). Fix: extract a severity(result) -> Option<Severity> helper and filter by severity.map_or(false, |s| s >= min_severity).
title: findings_at_or_above reimplements severity comparison instead of using derived Ord
